renameTrackingId.description: Internal rename-tracking identifier — NOT a query key. Use the field's `fieldKey` (one level up on this list-fields entry) for run-sql's `field_id` or a `wm_<fieldKey>` filter (e.g. "close_date"); this is an opaque, unrelated string (e.g. "cf_field_a1b2c3d4-..."), not a derivable variant of `fieldKey`. A couple of internal code paths (delete-field, remove-field-option) currently key lookups off this identifier instead of `fieldKey` — that is a known bug, not a second valid way to reference the field.

researchPrompt.description: For the built-in people field: who Multi-thread should research and which sources to use; never outreach.

ownerAgentId.description: Owning subagent's agent_id. Set = only that agent writes it.
